value.rationale: A 2026 primary paper asks for all finite groups and establishes only restricted classes. The theorem removes all group restrictions, supplies the full inverse-image identity for arbitrary subsets U and exact lengths n, works for general augmented finite-dimensional algebras, and isolates a sharp binary-field failure. It makes the previously conditional lifting criterion effective in every finite group algebra.
